summary: Extend wellmanifest/llm with bounded small-model decision slice budget

delivery.outcome: Add optional backward-compatible limits.maxDecisionSliceBytes (128..1024, reference 600) to wellmanifest/llm v1 profile/schema/conformance checker and document the llm-decision-slice-budget rule backed by 2026-11-21 live d1:3b A/B/C evidence.
nonGoals: No breaking changes to existing adopted wellmanifest.llm-profile/v1 consumers omitting maxDecisionSliceBytes
No SubLLM runtime routing implementation inside wellmanifest/llm

architecture.decision: Extend models/llm-profile.schema.json additively with optional limits.maxDecisionSliceBytes (128..1024), set 600 in models/subactor-first.v1.json, validate its range and budget hierarchy in docs/tools/conformance.py, add adversarial tests in docs/tools/test_decision_slice_budget.py, and document llm-decision-slice-budget in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
interfaceChanges: Additive optional property limits.maxDecisionSliceBytes on wellmanifest.llm-profile/v1

validation.evidence: make verify, conformance checks, existing regression tests, and new decision-slice budget tests all pass.
